name: Sonic Atlas
description: Your whole library as a map of how it sounds: calm to intense, dark to bright, coloured by musical key. Draw a line across it and hear a journey that follows it, mixed by key and tempo the way a DJ would. Everything is worked out on your server.
author: xo.st

fields.label: Map new songs in the background
fields.help: Each song is listened to once (a minute of it, from about a third of the way in) to place it on the map. New and changed songs are mapped as the library finds them.

fields.label: Speed
options: Gentle: one song at a time
fields.help: A song takes a few seconds, more when the music is on a network or cloud drive. Faster uses more of the server while it maps.
